hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import sys, json, subprocess, os
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
f = d.get('tool_input', {}).get('file_path', '')
if any(f.endswith(ext) for ext in ('.dtsi', '.keymap', '.conf')):
    env = dict(os.environ, PATH=os.path.expanduser('~/.local/bin') + ':' + os.environ.get('PATH', ''))
    r = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(f)), 'rev-parse', '--show-toplevel'], capture_output=True, text=True)
    repo = r.stdout.strip()
    if repo:
        subprocess.run(['bash', 'draw-keymap.sh'], cwd=repo, env=env)
"
